study: Physical-effect action codes, finite development study

interpretation.claim: No verified repair advantage for the tested implementation.
interpretation.successful_case: All methods selected nominal candidate 0 after three-way score ties; these are fallback successes, not learned-policy successes.
interpretation.failed_case: Only the ordinary action-code candidate survived the 24-decision search; its verification lost tracking at decision 40.
interpretation.effect_control: The two requested effect codes realized the same nearest effect class within each case; failed truncated branches are not successful code realization.
interpretation.statistical_scope: Two development roots with case and training seed coupled; no population success-rate or impossibility inference.
interpretation.next_method_constraint: Cluster membership predicts observed changes, not improvement over the nominal policy. Effect diversity and policy improvement need separate objectives and evidence.
